title: narrowing happens in a modal that writes what it did

criteria.text: Only the panel-opening control on the results surface; no chips or pills
criteria.note: `ActiveFilterChips`, `KindFilterPills` deleted in #174; BrowseSurface renders the search row with one filter-open control [V]. No guard asserts it

criteria.text: Apply closes the panel and writes the selection into the box as readable, retypable text
criteria.note: Sheet closes and sets `filters` state (schedule, tags). Nothing writes text to the box

criteria.text: Results match the box text, panel-written or typed
criteria.note: `searchBrowseResults` does free-text substring match only; filters come from separate state. Box text is not the state

criteria.text: Every string the panel can write is understood by the box reader
criteria.note: No grammar or parser exists; needs a round-trip over every panel selection

criteria.text: Text not understood opens the panel; never errors, never silently empties
criteria.note: Free text never errors, but unparsed text does not open the panel; empty state reads "Nothing here yet — try another filter". Replaces #57's chips fallback

criteria.text: Clearing the box clears the narrowing
criteria.note: Emptying the box clears the query only; sheet filters stay active with nothing visible. `clearAll` exists only behind the sheet's Clear all
